Reviewed 2026-07-13 from the post-restart replies + launch records; notification order matched launch order in every checkable case. task_id/tool_use_id/command/output_file are VERBATIM from the streams; status and exit_code are INFERRED (exit codes were never recorded; failures identified from the replies). All notification wordings are VERIFIED against 2.1.76 repros, incl. the failed-task wording ('failed with exit code N' — pinned by the --fail repro, 2026-07-13). recon_claude inserts a <task-notification> turn built from each entry; runs listed under 'deferred' keep the old (known-wrong) nudge insert plus a loud flag.
